plain: The idea that many different goals share the same useful stepping stones, like getting resources and not being switched off.
eli5: Whatever game you want to win, it helps to have more pieces and not be sent to bed.
technical: The thesis that for most final goals, sub-goals such as resource acquisition, self-preservation and keeping options open raise expected achievement, so capable optimisers tend to pursue them (formalised for optimal policies in MDPs by Turner et al. 2021).
